title: Jude and the Safehouse
author: Paloma Hartwell
blurb: Casper Yarrow, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
